lines.en: Wanda, although it rained all afternoon, I think the garden party was a success. People stayed until almost midnight.
lines.pt: Wanda, embora tenha chovido a tarde toda, acho que a festa no jardim foi um sucesso. As pessoas ficaram até quase meia-noite.

lines.en: I agree. Even though the tent leaked, nobody complained, and the music was better than I expected.
lines.pt: Concordo. Mesmo com o vazamento na tenda, ninguém reclamou, e a música foi melhor do que eu esperava.

lines.en: The tent was a disaster, though. Water dripped onto the dessert table, and I had to move everything inside.
lines.pt: A tenda foi um desastre, porém. A água pingou na mesa de sobremesas, e tive de levar tudo para dentro.

lines.en: You handled it well. I was surprised that your neighbours came, because they usually keep to themselves.
lines.pt: Você resolveu bem. Fiquei surpreso que seus vizinhos vieram, porque costumam ficar na deles.

lines.en: True. They brought homemade lemonade, which was great, since the weather turned cold. Honestly, I did not expect that.
lines.pt: É verdade. Trouxeram limonada caseira, que estava ótima, já que o tempo esfriou. Sinceramente, eu não esperava isso.

lines.en: By the way, the roses look fantastic. When did you plant them? They are already blooming.
lines.pt: Aliás, as rosas estão fantásticas. Quando você as plantou? Elas já estão florindo.

lines.en: Thanks. The soil in Austin is hard, but the secret is watering early in the morning before the heat arrives.
lines.pt: Obrigado. O solo em Austin é duro, mas o segredo é regar bem cedo de manhã, antes de o calor chegar.

lines.en: I should try that. My tomatoes stay small, although I water them every day. I wonder what I am doing wrong.
lines.pt: Preciso tentar isso. Meus tomates ficam pequenos, embora eu os regue todo dia. Me pergunto o que estou fazendo de errado.

lines.en: Maybe they need more sun. Mine grow near the fence, where they get light until six, even in October.
lines.pt: Talvez precisem de mais sol. As minhas crescem perto da cerca, onde pegam luz até as seis, até em outubro.

lines.en: Worth a try. Honestly, your whole garden looks like a postcard, especially after the storm yesterday.
lines.pt: Vale a pena tentar. Sinceramente, seu jardim inteiro parece um cartão-postal, ainda mais depois da tempestade de ontem.

lines.en: Come by on Sunday and take some cuttings, then. Although the forecast says rain again, we can drink coffee inside.
lines.pt: Passe aqui no domingo e leve algumas mudas, então. Embora a previsão diga chuva de novo, podemos tomar café lá dentro.

facts.label: although it rained
facts.sub: Use although + sujeito + verbo para opor duas ideias: Although it rained, we had a great time. Não use but na mesma frase. A vírgula separa as duas partes.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Although it rained, we had a great time is correct.

items.why: After although we need subject + verb.

items.s: Though can go at the end of a sentence.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Although it rained, we had a great time is correct. → Verdadeiro (Although + clause.)
We say “Although of the rain”. → Falso (After although we need subject + verb.)
Though can go at the end of a sentence. → Verdadeiro (Yes, informally.)

pages.title: After the garden party · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning in Austin. Dirk walks around his garden. The grass is still wet. Last night was his garden party. Rui arrives with fresh bread. They sit and talk about it.

“Rui, although it rained all afternoon, I think the garden party was a success. People stayed until almost midnight.” says Dirk. “I agree. Even though the tent leaked, nobody complained, and the music was better than I expected.” says Rui. “The tent was a disaster, though. Water dripped onto the dessert table, and I had to move everything inside.” says Dirk.
